hub.releaseNotes:
Ordrili 1.6.9
- Subscription & add-ons: see your plan and renew from the app (Subscription page, invoices, BaridiMob / Algérie Poste payments with proof upload).
- Payments: payment records with history, edit/void, refunds; take payment on earlier days' unpaid orders.
- Kitchen printing: printer or tablet kitchen mode, ticket text size, printing station on phones.
- Spot: finds the Hub again after its network address changes; clear reconnect screen (Try again / Find the server / Reset) instead of an endless spinner.
- Offline mode: calm "Offline mode" indicator when the internet drops — no reload prompts while the Hub keeps serving.
- Windows Hub: discoverable on the network like on Mac.
- Everyday polish: Tables and New Order layouts, boxed codes, How-To guide, menu photo cropping, and many fixes.
